verifications.claim: Voting for American Idol 2026 is open during live shows.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Voting takes place during each coast-to-coast live show'; R5: 'starting at 8 p.m. ET during the broadcast'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported by multiple references stating voting occurs during live broadcasts.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 live shows are typically Monday nights.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on Monday, April 6'; R2: 'Monday [April 6]'; R5: 'air on Monday, April 6... premieres on Mondays'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references confirm shows air on Monday nights.

verifications.claim: Viewers can vote up to 10 times per contestant per method for American Idol 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'up to 10 votes for each contestant per voting method'; R5: 'up to ten times per voting method'

verifications.claim: Voting for American Idol 2026 generally occurs at 8 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '"American Idol" airs at 8 p.m. ET'; R5: 'starting at 8 p.m. ET during the broadcast'
verifications.reasoning: Voting aligns with show start time of 8 p.m. ET; directly tied to broadcast timing.

verifications.claim: Online voting for American Idol 2026 is at idolvote.abc.com.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Online voting for American Idol 2026 requires an ABC account.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'You will need an ABC account'

verifications.claim: Text voting for American Idol 2026 involves texting contestant numbers to 21523.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'text the number of the contestant... to 21523'; R5: 'texting your favorite contestant\'s voting number to 21523'
verifications.reasoning: Precise match on method and number.

verifications.claim: Social media voting for American Idol 2026 is on official American Idol accounts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok by commenting on the pinned Official Vote Post.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Commenting on the pinned official voting post... on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok'; R5: 'through Instagram, TikTok, Facebook'
verifications.reasoning: Exact platforms and pinned post method confirmed.

verifications.evidence: R3: 'U.S., Puerto Rico or the U.S. Virgin Islands'; R4: 'U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands'

verifications.claim: Website and text voting for American Idol 2026 is for those aged 16+.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3/R4: Website '16 years old'; text age not specified
verifications.reasoning: Website clearly 16+, text age omitted in references.

verifications.claim: Social media voting for American Idol 2026 is for those aged 18+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'at least 18 years old... to vote on social media platforms'
verifications.reasoning: Explicit age requirement for social media.

verifications.claim: The dedicated American Idol app has been discontinued.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'You can’t use the “American Idol” app in 2026. That’s been discontinued.'

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting requires use of the website or mobile browser.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'website... or via text'; R4: 'browser... SMS text... social'; R5: 'five different ways: ... Instagram, TikTok, Facebook... text'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple methods exist beyond website/browser; claim implies only those.

verifications.claim: Voting for American Idol 2026 opens at the beginning of the broadcast.

verifications.claim: Voting for American Idol 2026 closes before the broadcast ends.
